title: WALT: Learning World-Model-Aligned Latent Trajectories for Autonomous Driving
description:
arXiv:2609.30436v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Driving world models learn rich predictive representations of the surrounding environment from visual observations, yet accurate visual prediction does not necessarily translate into effective trajectory planning. We argue that a key bottleneck lies in the mismatch between visual world states and raw geometric trajectories, which may limit the planner's ability to exploit action-relevant semantics encoded by the world model.
